purpose: Bind an approved production idea to one exact, content-addressed editorial brief.
hard_gates: Exact content address and canonical series identity must validate.
soft_gates: The brief should state a specific audience payoff and production intent.

failure.fallback: Return the invalid fields to the upstream editorial owner without inventing missing content.

regression_cases: Changed semantic content cannot reuse an existing brief identity.
A legacy public series alias cannot enter an approved brief.
